extracted.intended_audience: individuals and organizations who may be required to register under FARA (foreign agents), their legal counsel, and members of the public seeking FARA information
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on who must register under the Foreign Agents Registration Act and what disclosure, filing, and access procedures apply (including eFile authentication requirements and public office procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirement for agents of foreign principals
rubrics_metrics.description: FARA requires certain agents of foreign principals who are engaged in political activities or other activities specified under the statute to make periodic public disclosure of their relationship with the foreign principal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are an agent of a foreign principal and you engage in political activities or other activities covered by the statute, you must register. The page states this obligation as the primary trigger for filing registration statements under FARA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contents of required periodic public disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants must disclose their relationship with the foreign principal, as well as activities, receipts and disbursements in support of those activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The disclosures are intended to facilitate evaluation by the government and the American people of the activities of such persons in light of their function as foreign agents. The page emphasizes relationship, activities, receipts, and disbursements as the core required information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administration and enforcement responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The FARA Unit of the Counterintelligence and Export Control Section (CES) in the National Security Division (NSD) is responsible for the administration and enforcement of FARA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions about compliance, enforcement, or administrative matters should be directed to the FARA Unit (contact phone and email provided). This identifies the authoritative office for interpretations, filings, and enforcement actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: FARA eFile authentication requirement (DOJ Login & MFA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective February 6, 2026, the Department of Justice updated the FARA eFile system to utilize the DOJ Login platform for authentication of all new and existing users and requires enrollment in DOJ Login and registration of MFA credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All users must enroll in DOJ Login and register multi-factor authentication credentials to comply with federal cybersecurity requirements. The announcement includes a link and instructions to 'Sign up' for DOJ Login. The page also notes the eFile application is experiencing technical issues causing delays or inability to submit filings, and the technical team is working on a solution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of registration statements and public office procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration statements are available online at fara.gov by using available search tools; the FARA Unit Public Office is open on official business days by appointment only between 11 a.m. and 3 p.m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appointments are only necessary to review materials not currently available online. Contact information (phone, email) and physical office address are provided. Delivery hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m., and the public office hours are Monday–Friday, 11:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
